data.description: 5 test classes in test_cdg_contract.py are skipped because CDG (Conceptual Dependency Graph) is not yet implemented: TestCDGPointQueryContract, TestCDGPatternMatchContract, TestCDGPathQueryContract, TestCDGWriteContract, TestCDGThroughputContract. These are placeholder contracts for future functionality. When CDG is implemented, remove skips and calibrate thresholds to measured performance using 20% headroom methodology. This task should be linked to the CDG implementation epic when it exists.
